column1: # Things the engine must not invent.
# The target is the feel of MS-IME, and that reputation rests on not breaking
# rather than on being clever. Under that standard a reading coming back
# unconverted is fine — the user adds a word, or confirms it once and it is
# learned. What is not fine is producing something nobody asked for.
# So this file tests the opposite of word-level.tsv: `!surface` means the
# surface must not be the *first* candidate. Further down the list is fine —
# that is what a candidate list is for. Kana output passes.
# reading<TAB>!forbidden[|!forbidden...]
# Inflection expansion inventing words. 見ず is 文語 and mozc has no such row;
# ours manufactured it from み(見, 未然形) and it outranked 水.
# (食べず is not here: mozc carries it, so it is attested rather than invented.)
みず
かず
# Expansion must not attach た to a 五段 連用形 (書きた) or the wrong voicing
# to a euphonic stem (読んた, 泳いた).
かきた
よんた
およいた
のんた
はなしだ
# Segmentation must not merge across an obvious boundary and leave debris.
# 「明日の天気」+「はどう」→ 波動 is the λ over-merge.
あしたのてんきはどうですか
きょうはあつかった
# Function words must stay themselves rather than turning into rare nouns.
です
ですか
ました
